_doc: DATAGRAPH-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): "All Ultrastable deployments and systems shall have a knowledge graph (graph network) to automatically build and maintain a graph of connections for all data." Read by foundation/datagraph.py (--check in checks). Every system in instances/ultrastable/progress.json and every tenant in doctrine/tenant-repos.json has a row here. state 'seed-step': the system runs the seed tick Worker, whose step knowledge-graph (seed/worker/src/datagraph.js) builds the graph from every table of its D1. state 'pending': the system runs its own Worker; the core module is vendored into its repository (tenant-repos.json vendor) and the queue item named in 'item' wires it; the item's closing probe reads the system's own /api/graph. Research and design: docs/research/knowledge-graph.md.

replication-ledger.probe_from: the tenant worker route in doctrine/topology.json, once it has one
